CREATE TABLE audit_anchors (
  day         TEXT PRIMARY KEY,                   -- YYYY-MM-DD
  head_hash   TEXT NOT NULL,
  anchored_at TEXT NOT NULL,

)

CREATE TABLE circuit_state (
  tool_name     TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  state         TEXT NOT NULL,                    -- 'closed'|'open'|'half_open'

)

CREATE TABLE conflicts (
  id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  fact_a_id   INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES facts(id),
  fact_b_id   INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES facts(id),
  status      TEXT,
  detected_at TEXT,
  notes       TEXT
)

CREATE TABLE delta_cursors (
  session_id       TEXT NOT NULL,
  transcript_path  TEXT NOT NULL,
  last_byte_offset INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  PRIMARY KEY (session_id, transcript_path)
)

CREATE TABLE entities (
  id             INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  type           TEXT,
  canonical_name TEXT,
  slug           TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE
)

CREATE TABLE entity_aliases (
  entity_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES entities(id),
  alias     TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (entity_id, alias)
)

CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE external_chunks_fts USING fts5(
  content,
  content='',
  contentless_delete = 1,
  tokenize = 'unicode61'
)
CREATE TABLE 'external_chunks_fts_config'(k PRIMARY KEY, v) WITHOUT ROWID
CREATE TABLE 'external_chunks_fts_data'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, block BLOB)
CREATE TABLE 'external_chunks_fts_docsize'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, sz BLOB, origin INTEGER)
CREATE TABLE 'external_chunks_fts_idx'(segid, term, pgno, PRIMARY KEY(segid, term)) WITHOUT ROWID

CREATE TABLE external_store_meta (
  key   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  value TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE fact_affected_files (
  fact_id   INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES facts(id),
  file_path TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (fact_id, file_path)
)

CREATE TABLE fact_documents (
  fact_id     INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES facts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  document_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES external_documents(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  PRIMARY KEY (fact_id, document_id)
)

CREATE TABLE fact_links (
  from_fact_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES facts(id),
  to_fact_id   INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES facts(id),
  link_type    TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY (from_fact_id, to_fact_id, link_type)
)

CREATE TABLE fact_stats (
  fact_id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES facts(id),
  usage_count      INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  helpful_count    INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  outdated_reports INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  last_used_at     TEXT
)

CREATE TABLE fact_tags (
  fact_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES facts(id),
  tag     TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (fact_id, tag)
)

CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE facts_fts USING fts5(
  predicate,
  object_literal,
  content='facts',
  content_rowid='id',
  tokenize = 'unicode61'
)
CREATE TABLE 'facts_fts_config'(k PRIMARY KEY, v) WITHOUT ROWID
CREATE TABLE 'facts_fts_data'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, block BLOB)
CREATE TABLE 'facts_fts_docsize'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, sz BLOB)
CREATE TABLE 'facts_fts_idx'(segid, term, pgno, PRIMARY KEY(segid, term)) WITHOUT ROWID

CREATE TABLE mir_sign_consumed_nonces (
  nonce        TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  consumed_at  TEXT NOT NULL,
  phase_id     TEXT NOT NULL,
  family_id    TEXT NOT NULL,
  instance_id  TEXT
)

CREATE TABLE nuke_tokens (
  nonce       TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  instance_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  issued_at   TEXT NOT NULL,
  consumed_at TEXT
)

CREATE TABLE phase_gate_lock (
  id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1),
  holder        TEXT,
  acquired_at   TEXT
)

CREATE TABLE schema_meta (
  key   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  value TEXT
)

CREATE TABLE schema_migrations (
  version    TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  name       TEXT NOT NULL,
  applied_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TRIGGER facts_fts_ad AFTER DELETE ON facts BEGIN
  INSERT INTO facts_fts(facts_fts, rowid, predicate, object_literal)
  VALUES ('delete', old.id, old.predicate, old.object_literal);
END

CREATE TRIGGER facts_fts_ai AFTER INSERT ON facts BEGIN
  INSERT INTO facts_fts(rowid, predicate, object_literal)
  VALUES (new.id, new.predicate, new.object_literal);
END
